title: Equality of signed positions
statement: Let $l$ be a natural number, let $n$ and $m$ be natural-number counts on $2l$ counters, and let $i$ be one of the $l$ coordinates. Their signed positions at $i$ are equal if and only if the first-bank count of $n$ plus the second-bank count of $m$ equals the first-bank count of $m$ plus the second-bank count of $n$.
hypotheses_covered: Two natural-number count vectors on $2l$ counters
replaced: For movement-count vectors $n$ and $m$ and a coordinate $i$, the signed positions at $i$ agree exactly when the two cross-sums of first-bank and second-bank counts are equal; the criterion compares values rather than the non-unique two-counter codes.
